entities.summary: A 1.2 km mountain canopy walk and 32 m observation tower on the Spišská Magura ridge, with broad Tatra and Pieniny views and unusually strong family accessibility.
entities.description: The route rises gradually through the forest canopy to a panoramic tower and adds educational stations, a walkable high-level net and an optional 67 m dry slide. A gondola from Bachledova Valley makes the attraction practical for families, strollers and visitors with reduced mobility; current operator hours should still be checked before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: One of Slovakia’s strongest family-friendly nature structures: the long elevated forest route, mountain panorama and accessible gondola approach make it substantially more destination-worthy than a routine lookout.

audience.notes: Official visitor information explicitly describes the walk as suitable for children, teenagers and adults and provides stroller, baby-carrier and wheelchair support. Infant/toddler fit remains limited rather than a default positive match; children under 14 require adult supervision.
